name: robots/luccachiang__gsworld
title: GSWorld RealFr3-v1 (empty scene, FR3 UMI)
intro: GSWorld RealFr3-v1 (empty scene, FR3 UMI), adapted from luccachiang/gsworld. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
